messages:
deepa: Quick sync — we need to decide sequencing for three Q3 initiatives: (1) Dedicated throughput (FinCorp ask, ~5w), (2) Optimize batching/caching (broad cost impact, ~8w partial overlap), (3) Private rollout polish (compliance, ~3w). Recommend applying RICE + constraints from staffing. Opinions?

liam: Short take — FinCorp is on a trial and pushing hard. If revenue & SLA come through, Dedicated moves up. But we only have limited runtime engineers.

maya: From GTM: FinCorp conversion probability looks high (~40%) if we hit their live SLA. That bumps impact for Dedicated.

josh: Infra reality — only 2 engineers can touch the serving runtime this quarter without blocking other work. If both focused on Dedicated, Optimize will lag ~6w. I prefer a minimal baseline for Dedicated + parallel prep for Optimize.

eva: Let's actually score with RICE quickly. I'll assume Reach = number of customers affected, Impact 1-10, Confidence 1-10, Effort in engineer-weeks.

eva: ```
RICE formula: (Reach * Impact * Confidence) / Effort
Estimates:
- Dedicated baseline: Reach=8 (FinCorp + similar), Impact=7, Confidence=6, Effort=5w => (8*7*6)/5 = 67.2
- Optimize (batching/caching): Reach=20 (all hosted + dedicated), Impact=9, Confidence=7, Effort=8w => (20*9*7)/8 = 315
- Private polish: Reach=2 (enterprise regulated), Impact=6, Confidence=5, Effort=3w => (2*6*5)/3 = 20
```

sven-sre: Ops note — shipping Dedicated baseline will temporarily increase paging as we tune GPU pools and autoscaling. Plan 1 extra week of oncall overlap after canary.

ken-design: UI/UX: Dedicated admin flow is small (1–2 screens). Optimize needs UX for visibility into batching & token-cost changes (2w design). We can parallelize design work.

deepa: Thanks — RICE pushes Optimize to the front numerically, but staffing and customer urgency push Dedicated. Proposal: do minimal Dedicated baseline (canary) now + run Optimize prep tasks in parallel (design, metrics, a small infra spike) so we reduce blocking later. Canary plan: 10% traffic for 72h.

liam: Implementation plan I suggest: sprint 1 (2 wks) — Judah + Priya on Dedicated baseline; Mei on Optimize prep (design handoff, metrics pipeline). sprint 2 — if canary healthy, shift one infra eng to Optimize work. That keeps both moving.

maya: I'll update the roadmap with new gating criteria. Proposed launch criteria: Dedicated baseline = baseline SLA + canary success (latency delta <10% and error rate <0.5% over 72h). Optimize stage 1 = measurable cost reduction (>=12% on sample) + no generation regressions on eval suite.

josh: Also add fallback routing to hosted models in case Dedicated overloads. I filed INF-742 for the routing/fallback ticket.

deepa: Great. @liam can you confirm headcount and update INF-742 + attach the mini-PRD by EOD? I'll sync with Sales about canary dates.

liam: Confirmed — Judah, Priya assigned to Dedicated baseline; Mei on Optimize prep. Will update INF-742 and attach PRD by 6pm PT.

maya: Thanks team. I'll schedule a 15m follow-up tomorrow to lock timeline and customer comms. :calendar:

deepa: Perfect — pushing this into the queue and we'll reconvene after the canary starts.
